description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
